results.title: J. Nagendra Kumar Re-elected President of Jappinamogaru Ganeshotsava Committee
results.description: J. Nagendra Kumar Re-elected President of Jappinamogaru Ganeshotsava Committee Mangaluru: J. Nagendra Kumar, former corporator, has been re-elected as the president of the Jappinamogaru Public Sri Ganeshotsava Committee for its 18th annual Ganeshotsava celebrations, marking the beginning of preparations for the forthcoming festivities.
